text:
## 页面标题与说明文字
- 标题：**Clinical trials (IIS/ECR/ONIS)**
- 说明：依据**Section 3.4**，每个试验的**Sponsorship**与**Trial Operations**应在下表所述对应里程碑后尽快转移。
- 页脚：
  - **Boehringer Ingelheim**（标识）
  - Source：**Outlicense and Transfer Agreement (OTA) - Exhibit 6.4, CTSA, Appendix 1**
  - **Privileged and Confidential. For internal use only**
  - 页码：**70**
  - 注释：**Clinical trials and Post Marketing Studies (PMS/PhIV) to be found in “CLINICAL TRIALS” section**

## 表格（可见列名）
- **Study**
- **Indication**
- **Description**
- **Category**
- **Sponsorship Transfer / Milestone**
- **Anticipated Timing**
- **Trial Operations Transfer / Milestone**
- **Anticipated Timing**
- **Comment**
- **Submission activities**

## 表格内容（仅摘录清晰可读/可辨识的行要点）
1) **1368-0150**
- Description：**PhIV Observe (US in plan & CHN terminated)**
- Sponsorship Transfer / Milestone：**n/a To be canceled**
- Trial Operations Transfer / Milestone：**To be canceled**
- Comment：**-**

2) **1368-0141**
- Description：**IPF Registry Study - ONIS (data-based)**

3) **1368-0147**
- Description：**GPP Registry in the US & Canada (CorEvitas, PASS)**
- Comment（可读）：**Decision Resources Inc./Clarivate as service provider under FrameWork Agreement**
- Submission activities（可读）：**Part of the submission package for the 01340 to be handled by…**（后半截不可辨清）

4) **1368-0155**
- Description：**Clinical Outcomes Assessment Research - ONIS HECQ (2 Parts)**

5) **1368-0152**
- Description：**Real world data on pyoderma gangrenosum in North America**
- Comment（要点可读）：
  - **Ortega is the investigator**
  - **Oregon Health and Science University is the institute**
  - **contact is assignable**
- Submission activities（可读）：**Part of the submission package for the 01340 to be handled by…**（后半截不可辨清）

6) **tbd1**
- Description：**Natural course: sequester (finished) & part 2 (planned) - US data based**
- Sponsorship/Trial Operations 相关（可读要点）：**Part 1 completed data not meaningful, Part 2 therefore canceled; 0181 to supplement**（大意）

7) **1368-0137**
- Description（可读要点）：**investigation of patient-physician treatment goals and their differences in…**（结尾不可辨清）
- Comment：**contracts are assignable**

8) **1368-0181**
- Indication：**PG**
- Description：**PG: US burden and treatment pattern**
- Submission activities：**Supportive for HTA**
- Comment：**Contracts with Omny Inc.**

9) **1368-0081**
- Indication：**all indications**
- Description：**[Speci…] Out of Scope / Named Patient Use requests**（部分不可辨）
- Comment（可读要点）：**LEO does not intend to continue the Out-of-Scope program**

## 可见“决定/结论”（从表格文字提取）
- **To be canceled / To be terminated**（至少在 1368-0150 等行出现）
- **Part 2 therefore canceled**（tbd1 行）
- **LEO does not intend to continue the Out-of-Scope program**（1368-0081 行）

## 可见“行动项”（页面上以可执行表述呈现的内容）
- 根据 Section 3.4：在对应里程碑后**尽快完成 Sponsorship 与 Trial Operations 的转移**（作为页面规则性要求）
- 多处提及**submission package**与“handled by …”（表明需纳入提交材料并由某方处理，但具体负责人在截图中不清晰）
